faults.name: blocked
faults.symptom: connection refused from the network, though the process is running

error_log: 2026/11/17 04:03:58 [error] 73873#73873: *3 open() "labs/week06/site/index.html" failed (13: Permission denied), client: 127.0.0.1, server: , request: "GET / HTTP/1.1", host: "127.0.0.1:8080"

2026/11/17 04:03:58 [error] 73877#73877: *2 connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream, client: 127.0.0.1, server: , request: "GET /api/ HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://127.0.0.1:9099/", host: "127.0.0.1:8080"

faults.cause: the listener was bound to 127.0.0.9, so nothing answers on 127.0.0.1 — the local equivalent of a security-group rule that excludes your address
faults.fix: restore the intended listen address, reload, re-test

faults.name: service down
faults.symptom: site unreachable; nothing answers on the port

error_log: 2026/11/17 04:03:58 [error] 73873#73873: *3 open() "labs/week06/site/index.html" failed (13: Permission denied), client: 127.0.0.1, server: , request: "GET / HTTP/1.1", host: "127.0.0.1:8080"

2026/11/17 04:03:58 [error] 73877#73877: *2 connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream, client: 127.0.0.1, server: , request: "GET /api/ HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://127.0.0.1:9099/", host: "127.0.0.1:8080"

faults.cause: nginx was not running — no listener, so the TCP connection is refused before HTTP exists
faults.fix: start the service, then confirm with a request rather than a process check

faults.name: config error
faults.symptom: service will not (re)start after a change

evidence.nginx_t: 2026/11/17 04:05:00 [emerg] 74436#74436: unknown directive "worker_processes_on_holiday" in labs/week06/runtime/nginx.conf:31 | nginx: configuration file labs/week06/runtime/nginx.conf test failed

faults.cause: an unknown directive was appended to the config; nginx validates the whole file before it starts
faults.fix: restore the generated config (never hand-edit), re-run nginx -t, then start

faults.name: permission denied
faults.symptom: 403 Forbidden for a page that exists

error_log: 2026/11/17 04:03:58 [error] 73877#73877: *2 connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream, client: 127.0.0.1, server: , request: "GET /api/ HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://127.0.0.1:9099/", host: "127.0.0.1:8080"
2026/11/17 04:05:01 [error] 74450#74450: *3 open() "labs/week06/site/index.html" failed (13: Permission denied), client: 127.0.0.1, server: , request: "GET / HTTP/1.1", host: "127.0.0.1:8080"

faults.cause: the document was mode 000 — the worker could not read it, so nginx returned 403 rather than 404
faults.fix: restore readable permissions (0644), and check ownership the same way

faults.name: dead upstream
faults.symptom: one route returns 502 while the rest of the site is fine

error_log: 2026/11/17 04:05:01 [error] 74450#74450: *3 open() "labs/week06/site/index.html" failed (13: Permission denied), client: 127.0.0.1, server: , request: "GET / HTTP/1.1", host: "127.0.0.1:8080"

2026/11/17 04:05:01 [error] 74454#74454: *2 connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream, client: 127.0.0.1, server: , request: "GET /api/ HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://127.0.0.1:9099/", host: "127.0.0.1:8080"

faults.cause: proxy_pass pointed at 127.0.0.1:9099 where nothing was listening; the error log names the refused connection
faults.fix: start the upstream service and re-test the same route
